book.name: MATTA
book.title: Matta Laɓara na Mbǝnggǝn aten Yeeso

content: Yanang Yeeso Famalǝngya ngyakhrha
Tǝrgha Yeeso ndanggǝn fiya wumngga hai tǝ fatsahayighǝn,
“Famalǝmgya ngyakhrha tǝ Farisaya kanda ni nggǝmang na nda kanda fa a pǝr ngyakhrha Musa nda.
Nanǝn kee tsahama tǝ ƙǝm ǝna taara nun tǝ ˈya ndang nanda kun, amma a ǝnaɗun kǝla nanda ǝnaarha wa, ƙǝsǝr mba nda ǝna ˈya na nanda a tsaharhaha wa.
Nanda ɗǝfang rǝfrha fiya in na haghǝn, amma kanda tǝ alten ndan mba nda thlar kanda ko tǝ wan haara wa.”
Na nda ǝna tar ndan ka a nagha fiya kanda, nanda ƙǝn masparma natǝ chireethla laɓar Faara a pǝmnggindan, na nda ndǝn pǝratsan nzǝnzang a mii karindan.
Yakh mid ndan tsaurha a mbǝd tsaukya na nggǝngga hu teera, tǝ kǝm mbǝd tsaukya natǝ thlǝma a ƙǝn tsahad Yahudaya.
Na mid ndan a ndangˈya nda kanda yi mamnggirha a nan nda a wiirha hai ahu kasu, tǝ ƙǝm nagha fiya a aah kanda, Mala.
“A nggǝmna fa a aah sa nda ‘Mala,’ wa ƙǝsǝr tǝmalǝmnda tǝtal ni, kun heu nuwun tal a wanmanggi.
A aah ɗun kowunni ahu ƙǝshidɗi ya ‘Pǝpa’ wa, ƙǝsǝr Faara na talara ndǝna Pǝpa hu Sǝsǝna.
A nggǝmna fa aagha kowunni sa ‘Mala’ wa, ƙǝsǝr tǝmalǝmnda tǝtali ni, ndǝna, Ƙǝrǝsti.
Yi na manggǝn ahur nun tǝta ni a tsauka mafad nun.
Amma kala nafiya manangga altenggindan nanda tsaurha ngguchit, tǝ kǝm nafiya tsawangga altenggindan ngguchit nanda manang kanda.

“Amma kawama, kun famalǝmngya ngyakhrha Musa tǝ Farisaya, fathlǝrɓuya! Nggǝlanggun kwatminda kyarha hu kutǝryid talara ɗǝ ma fiya. Kun tafad nun kyawun sa ɗǝ wa, ˈyaɗang kwamana nun fiya na mindan kyarha sa ɗǝ.”
Kawama famalǝmngya Ngyakhrha tǝ Farisaya, ndirwiya, nun hǝb karid nishya mǝrna chimayi ndan, non naarha hwan Faara kaan ka a na kun nda. Tsaunǝn kee na nda a ngwang kumarha kun sǝ na pǝɗaghǝn.

Kawama, famalǝmgya ngyakhrha tǝ Farisaya, fathlǝrɓuya! Nun wii tala aten chehweerha tǝ wuri aama ka wal niifa nun malangga ɗimiyidghǝn, a malang ɗǝ ɗimiyidghǝn, nun sǝɓang nda ɗǝ kaan kal kun nǝn ɗimiyirha.

Kawama, kwamaya na kyad kwamana! Nun ndaarha, “Kala niifa aagha thlǝm Faara tǝ Ƙǝn Faara, mbǝ ɓillarha sǝ wa, amma kaala niifa aagha thlǝm Faara tǝ tǝfasa yi Ƙǝn Faara, tsau ɗǝ tǝta a ǝna ǝnɗa nǝn aah nǝn Faara a tenggǝn.”
Kun nur kwamaya! Yanggi ni manggǝn, tǝfasa wa nduwa Ƙǝn Faara na a Urshalima tsaɓangga tǝfasa ɗǝ wa?
Nun ndaarha, “Kaala niifa aagha Faara tǝ ‘mbǝd fǝr Sataka,’ mbǝ ɓillarha sǝ wa, amma niifa aagha thlǝm Faara tǝ ǝnfǝra na a mbǝd ǝna Sataka, tǝtani ǝna ǝnɗa nǝn ndanǝn nǝn a ǝnaarha.”
Kun kwamaya! Yanggini manggǝn, ǝnfǝrɗi wa nduwa mbǝd nji sataka tsaɓangga ǝnfǝr ɗaɗǝ wa?
Tsaunǝn kee, kala niifa aagha thlǝm Faara tǝ mbǝd nji ǝnfǝra, aah nǝn Faara tǝ ˈya na tenggǝn heu.
A anna thlǝm Faara tǝ Ƙǝn Faara na a Urshalima, aah na thlǝm Faara na tǝ tsaurha a mbǝɗi.
A anna thlǝm Faara tǝ Talara, na aah tsǝnggam Faara, tǝ ndǝghǝn na tǝ tsaurha ahu tsǝnggamɗi.

Kawama famalǝmngya ngyakhrha Musa tǝ farisaya, fathlǝrɓuya! Nun fǝr ǝn fǝrrǝ nun tal ahu kum yi shi chimbee amma malanggun ǝngya na nggǝngga ahu ngyakhrha, ndǝna, ƙǝkafek, haɗang ndan fa, tǝ nggayirha. Ənggina ni kamngga na nggǝngga a ǝnon ya, a malang ɗun fingya wa.
Kun kwamaya fa kyad kwamana, nun kang aama hai amawa nun muɗang kukwakhtaara amma nun muɗang thlǝkhmu.
Kawama, famalǝmgya ngyakhrha Musa tǝ Farisaya, fathlǝrɓuya! Nun tsaɓang ƙǝsǝr wuhuleurha ɗǝ tǝ tasau, amma ahurghǝn nǝghǝn lǝlǝgɗa tǝ nggǝm alteena tǝ hukrha!
Sa kwamad tǝfarisarha! Tsaɓang hur wuhuleurha ɗǝ tǝ tasau ˈwan, tǝna ƙǝsǝrghǝn narha tsǝtsaɓaɗǝ ƙǝm.

“Kawama, famalǝmgya ngyakhrha Musa tǝ Farisaya, fathlǝrɓuya! Nuwun kǝla ten kwaya ƙǝmang nanda tǝ penti na pǝpet, nagha ngga hu yirha, amma hurghǝn lǝlǝgɗa tǝ aal nafiya mǝrgha tǝ paarha ɗǝɗamǝn-ɗǝɗamǝn.
Tǝ ƙǝm ahu yirha naa fiya a na kun ka nafiya, amma ahur nun sǝ nuwun lǝlǝgɗa tǝ thlǝrɓuyirha tǝ mbǝlfeerha.”
“Kawama, famalǝmgya ngyakhrha Musa tǝ Farisaya, fathlǝrɓuya! Nun tǝn ten kwaya a annabiya, tǝ kǝm nun sakhɗang nda ten kwaya yi ka fiya fǝrgha ƙǝkafek a Faara.
Tǝrgha nun ndaarha, ‘Andam nǝghǝm sǝ a sayid chichiyinǝm, kam ɗangwan kanda sǝ ɓǝlang nda annabiya wa.’
Amma a naɗun a ndaarha kee, nun a thlǝghanggǝn altennun tǝ ndaarha kunni chichiya nafini ɓǝlangga annabi yini.
Ɗama mbeeɗǝ ngwalanggǝn ˈya katǝrangna chichiyi nun hai.”
Kun huthlingya, wangya huthlingya na tǝ mbǝlfeerha yid! Ƙǝƙǝn nun hǝrǝkrha ma ngwa kumad hwanga?

Tsaunǝn kee niya thlǝnang annabiya kun ɗǝ tǝ fasǝngya, tǝ famalǝmngya ngyakhrha Musa. Amma nun a ɓǝlang fingya tǝ taurha ɗǝ, nun a tsaɗa fingya ahu ƙǝn tsahad Yahudaya, nun takkwa kanda tala-tala, kun a sǝsang kanda.

Tsaunǝn kee, niya thlǝnang nafina ɗǝ ya ƙǝsǝr na hakked ka nafini ɓǝlang nun a tsaurha a ten nun heu ka a sayi far Habila kaniifa ɗǝgha ten Dzakariya wan Mberikiya, ɓǝlang nun a pathlang Ƙǝn Faara na a Urshalima tǝ mbǝd ǝna sataka.
Niya pǝrang kǝkafek kun, na ǝnggini a katǝrarha hai hu ƙǝshiid weeriya.
Sǝb hur Yeeso ɗǝ aten Urshalima

Aiya Urshalima, Urshalima! Fa ɓǝl annabiya tǝ muk fathlǝngya Faara tǝ feera thlǝnna nda thlǝmadwa ɗǝ! Saara kurmi tǝrna minna a wumanggi kun kamuna ɓa kǝla na ɗiyarha ngwang wanggighǝn kamughǝn ɗǝ, amma karɗun fa.
Kǝlama hai nanǝnya, malang nda wuri nun kun fa tsauɗǝ kwad wure.
Ƙǝsǝr niya pǝranggǝn kun, mbun a nggǝr na nggi ɓal wa ƙǝl fara ndanun, “Tǝ parkani niifɗi na a ɓarha ɓa hu thlǝm Chinǝm.”

footnotes.text: Matta 6:1; Ɗeleewar Kirassa 15:38; Nggurub Ngwa Kumaarha 6:8
